# 20% discount on everything in our merchandising shop March 4th - March 12th, 2023

## New design

Are you also mutated and strange by the dozen? Then our new design is just right for you!

## Discount promotion

Our merchandising shop is now online again and offers you the next discount promotion: **20% OFF everything from March 4th to March 12th, 2023**

The Merchandising Shop is another channel to **support** us and **donate** in this form. In return you get cool shirts, sweaters, mugs and much more with a funny (perhaps ironic) saying or the Nuka Knights logo. If you have ideas for other sayings and motifs, please write in the comments.
